cases.case_label: 5.6 kb L1 c.2106_2107ins in exon 4 of RP1 (dominant RP)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 5,571-bp L1 insertion (5' 1,635 bases inverted, 15-bp TSD, polyA) in RP1 exon 4, characterised by targeted adaptive nanopore sequencing, introduces a premature stop codon 10 bp downstream of the insertion, producing a truncating allele that segregates with dominant RP in a three-generation family.
cases.quote: Taken together, we describe a novel 5.6 kb LINE-1 transposable element insertion in exon 4 of RP1 in a Finnish family with dominantly inherited RP.
